title: Lecturers have more connections than you think… #engineering #electricalengineering #university
transcript: the solution to I don't have any experience. Speak to your lecturers. Your lecturers have been working in the field for a very long time. Probably they know quite a few people. You don't lose anything going up to your lecturer, especially the one you like and being like, "Hey, I'm really interested in the thing that you're teaching. Could I help you out with something? Do you know anyone that needs help? This is something. This is something you can do. If you're really good at maths, you're in your final year. Maybe you can become a teaching assistant." And this is this benefits you because you get better at maths and it benefits someone else. This is a win-win situation.
